# rixl_feed (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_feed" "main" {
  project_id  = var.rixl_project_id
  name        = "main"
  description = "Primary content feed"

  allow_images = true
  allow_videos = true
  has_likes    = true
  has_shares   = true
  has_comments = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `allow_images` (Boolean)
- `allow_videos` (Boolean)
